decisions.reason: As a core application unit close to the firm's established resin-processing business, it likely benefits from prior engineering and commercialization investment that management will be reluctant to write off.
This second resin injection unit also fits the firm's stated direction and installed capabilities, so escalation of commitment makes continued support more likely than withdrawal.
An automatic airless spray gun sits squarely in the firm's core spray-equipment offering, and a medium German machinery firm would usually keep such a launched model unless failure is unmistakable.
The manual airless spray gun is highly aligned with the firm's traditional product scope and service network, which supports persistence after launch.
Because this is a full product line with several models, the sunk investment and visible market commitment are highest, making management especially likely to continue with it.
The data logger appears more peripheral to the firm's main machinery business and already had reduced website prominence by 2019, so it is easier to discontinue if results disappointed.
